entities.name: PMID:25098850
observations: 2014 prospective study of 140 total hip or knee replacement patients comparing surgeon-estimated blood loss with calculated loss using a modified Gross formula.

entities.name: Arthroplasty blood loss underestimation
observations: In 140 hip or knee replacements, surgeon-estimated blood loss was below calculated loss in 98/140 (70%) and above it in 42/140 (30%).
Estimation accuracy decreased significantly when average blood loss exceeded 500 mL; authors cautioned against relying on clinical estimation alone for transfusion decisions.
